title: Replace the unlicensed Vortex Stop hook with a real pre-push quality gate
summary: main in ins and animals replaced a no-op Stop hook (running `sonar analyze agentic`, a feature this DEFRA SonarCloud org does not have licensed) with a PreToolUse(Bash) hook that runs tools/sonar/sonar-push-check.sh on an actual `git push` and blocks the push on a failing quality gate. The branch predates this fix in both repos (it still carries the old .claude/sonar-analyze.sh file and Stop hook from the original EUDPA-371 SonarCloud setup, untouched since) and merges it in cleanly with zero conflict -- the merged .claude/settings.json is byte-identical to main's. plants-frontend's main never received this fix at all: plants's .claude/settings.json and .claude/sonar-analyze.sh are byte-identical between main and the branch, both still running the broken Stop hook. Separately: main made no changes to any .github/workflows/* file in any of the four repos in this window, so this sync introduces no new workflow_run risk; the one pre-existing workflow_run risk (lighthouse.yml calling scripts/npm-version.js) was already resolved by the branch's own ruling-17 follow-up commits.

files.note: Verified: the trial-merged tree's .claude/settings.json is byte-for-byte identical (diff exit 0) to main's copy. Branch's only difference from main pre-merge is that it still has the old Stop-hook shape from EUDPA-371 (186282c), never touched since.
Deletion applies cleanly; the merged tree's `git ls-tree` has no .claude/sonar-analyze.sh entry.
Same verification as ins: merged tree's file diffs empty against main's copy.

plants main never made this change (log over the merge-base..main range for .claude/ is empty). main and branch are byte-identical (same git tree object 2ab877f... for the whole .claude/ directory), both still running the old Stop hook that calls `sonar analyze agentic --force`.

branchEquivalent.evidence: ins and animals: the branch's .claude/ tree dates from EUDPA-371 (feat(EUDPA-371): turn on SonarCloud CI analysis and Claude Code integration) and was never touched again on the branch -- confirmed via `git log --oneline origin/feat/NO_JIRA-frontend-alignment -- .claude/sonar-analyze.sh` returning only that one commit. plants: main and branch are identical (same tree sha), i.e. plants has no equivalent on either side.

verdictWhy: ins and animals merge with zero conflicts and the merged result is provably byte-identical to main's fixed version -- no hand resolution needed, just land the merge. plants is a separate, out-of-scope gap (main hasn't adopted the fix there), not something this sync should invent on the branch's own initiative.

resolutions.take: Accept the merge as-is (git's own 3-way merge already produces main's exact content).
resolutions.why: Proven byte-identical to main by direct diff; nothing for a human or agent to decide.

preAlign.what: Could cherry-pick 392afac directly onto the branch now instead of waiting for the main-merge.
preAlign.why: Optional only -- the merge already resolves this with zero conflict, so pre-aligning buys nothing extra here beyond one fewer file touched in the merge commit's diff.

behaviourChanges: ins and animals: a `git push` from a Claude Code session now runs the real local build/test/SonarCloud pipeline via tools/sonar/sonar-push-check.sh and blocks the push if the quality gate fails, replacing a Stop hook that silently did nothing every turn.
plants is unaffected by this cluster -- it keeps running the no-op Stop hook until a separate fix lands on its own main.
knockOn: None for ins/animals beyond what's already documented workspace-wide (CLAUDE.md's SonarCloud integration section): SONAR_TOKEN must be set locally or the hook skips gracefully.

openQuestions.question: Should plants-frontend get the same sonar-pre-push-gate fix as ins and animals, given its main still runs the broken, unlicensed Vortex Stop hook?
openQuestions.default: Out of scope for this sync -- main decides behaviour and plants's main hasn't adopted the fix yet. Raise it as a separate, ordinary fix PR against trade-imports-plants-frontend's main, independent of this merge.

workflowRisks.risk: main has no lighthouse.yml at all (confirmed via `git ls-tree origin/main -- .github/workflows/`), so there is no workflow_run risk introduced by main in this window -- the branch's own lighthouse.yml simply cannot fire via workflow_run until this branch reaches main. This is the pre-existing, already-documented 'Known caveat' in report.md, not a new finding.

Unchanged by main in this window (empty `git log mergeBase..main -- .github/workflows`). It already depends on scripts/npm-version.js and the packageManager field, which the branch restored specifically because a workflow_run job runs MAIN's copy of lighthouse.yml, which still calls that script -- already resolved by ruling 17's follow-up commits (f9c9bce, 780ec235, bcc7166), not a new risk from this sync.
Same shape and same resolution as animals.

main changed zero .github/workflows/*.yml files in any of the four repos since each repo's own merge base (verified with `git diff --stat <mergeBase> origin/main -- .github/workflows` returning no output in every repo). This sync therefore introduces no new workflow_run drift of any kind; every workflow_run consideration on the table is pre-existing and already handled by the branch's own tooling-convergence stage (s20/ruling 17).
